name: transition-pixel-dissolve
title: Pixel Dissolve
description: Khung chia thành các ô vuông nhỏ, mỗi ô đổi sang cảnh mới ở một thời điểm ngẫu nhiên cố định, không mờ dần.

moworks.author: takayu

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tr-pixel, written here): Frame divided into square cells (16 px on a 320 px frame = 5 % of width); each cell gets a fixed seeded threshold 0..1; progress 0 -> 1 linear over 600 ms; a cell switches from old to new scene on the frame progress passes its threshold (hard per-cell cut, no fade). Params: cell (5 % chiều ngang) · duration (0.6 s) · seed.
